tiers.name: Tier 1: KTransformers 双路 CPU AMX + 单卡 48GB GPU 异构方案 (专家放 1TB DDR5 内存)
tiers.name_en: Tier 1: KTransformers Dual-Socket CPU AMX + Single 48GB GPU Hybrid (Experts in 1TB DDR5 DRAM)
tiers.hardware_spec: 2x Intel Xeon Granite Rapids (AMX, 24-ch DDR5 ~900 GB/s) + 1x RTX 4090D / L40S 48GB
tiers.recommended_for: 5–20 person R&D teams or air-gapped PoC labs needing full 671B R1 reasoning under a $25K budget (1–4 concurrent users).

tiers.name: Tier 2: 双机 16×H100/H800 80GB 混部 TP=16 (FP8，受困于跨机 RoCE 同步与 Prefill 干扰)
tiers.name_en: Tier 2: 2-Node 16xH100/H800 80GB Colocated TP=16 (FP8, Cross-Node RoCE Barrier & Prefill Interference)
tiers.recommended_for: Legacy H100/H800 inventory reuse only; cross-node TP=16 wastes 46% step time on network barriers and suffers P/D interference.

tiers.name: Tier 3: 单机 8×H200 (1,128GB) / 8×MI300X (1,536GB) FP8 + MTP 多 Token 投机解码
tiers.name_en: Tier 3: Single-Node 8xH200 (1,128GB) / 8xMI300X (1,536GB) FP8 + MTP Speculative Decoding
tiers.hardware_spec: 1 Node × 8xH200 141GB (1,128 GB HBM3e) or 8xMI300X 192GB, Intra-Node NVLink/xGMI TP=8 + MTP=1
tiers.recommended_for: 90% of enterprise private deployments (500–3,000 employees, <=100 concurrent active requests): 1 server fits full 671B FP8 + MTP.

tiers.name: Tier 4: 4 节点 32×H200 PD 分离 (2P+2D) + Attention DP + DeepEP 专家并行 + Mooncake KV

tiers.recommended_for: Large enterprise AI platforms (>500 concurrent sessions, 10,000+ employees) requiring strict P99 TTFT/TPOT isolation and lowest $/1M tokens.
